solution: Restarted the workers with the month-end batch disabled, then ran the batch on a separate job.
short_description: orders-worker killed for memory during the month-end batch
trigger: Month-end report batch ran inside orders-worker and loaded every order of the month into memory.
problem_statement: The month-end report batch ran inside orders-worker and loaded every order of the month into memory. Workers hit their 512Mi limit and were killed again and again for just over an hour.
impact_description: Confirmations up to 40 minutes late for about 5,200 orders. No orders lost.
impact_metrics: Confirmations up to 40 minutes late for about 5,200 orders.
immediate_resolution: Disabled the batch flag and restarted the workers.

timeline.event: Month-end batch started inside orders-worker. None.
Alert OrdersWorkerOOMKilled fired. On-call restarted the workers.
Workers killed again within minutes of each restart. Paged the orders team.
Orders team found the batch loading the whole month into memory. Disabled the batch flag and restarted the workers.
Workers stable and the backlog cleared. Closed the incident.

root_causes: The month-end batch loaded all orders of the month into worker memory at once. The batch ran inside orders-worker, so its memory use killed the order consumer too.

action_items.action: Move the month-end batch to its own scheduled job.
Read orders in pages of 1,000 in the batch.
